_readme: Teams are created by students for team-based competitions.
A team belongs to a specific competition and has a captain (creator).
competition_slug   slug of the competition this team is for
captain_id         user ID of the team captain
member_ids         list of user IDs (includes captain)
max_size           maximum team size for this competition
min_size           minimum team size for this competition
registration_id    registration ID if team is registered (optional)
